name: Autodidact

description.content: You start the trial with [0] Tokens, up to [5], and your good basic healing Skill Checks give [15%] less progress.
While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit:

items: Earn [1] Token for each basic Skill Check.
For each Token, gain [15%] more progress.
You cannot get great Skill Checks.

quote: "There's no limit to what you can achieve, as long as you back it up with hard work." -Adam Francis
